question: Should OpenClaw remove these released root bundled skills now and ship Sherpa ONNX TTS as an official ClawHub-only plugin in the same release change?
rationale: The implementation generally follows the lean-core and plugin-ownership direction, but it intentionally changes shipped skill availability, persisted configuration behavior, official installation trust, dependency metadata, and native artifact distribution.

options.title: Land after migration and trust approval
options.body: Add and prove the bundled-skill upgrade migration or deprecation contract, then obtain exact-head dependency and Sherpa artifact approvals before merging.

options.title: Split Sherpa from skill trimming
options.body: Land the ClawHub-only Sherpa package separately if that trust path is ready while retaining the released bundled-skill set until its migration plan is approved.

options.title: Park the broad removal
options.body: Keep the existing bundled set and close or pause this branch until a release owner sponsors the deprecation and support plan.

recommendation.title: Land after migration and trust approval
recommendation.body: Add and prove the bundled-skill upgrade migration or deprecation contract, then obtain exact-head dependency and Sherpa artifact approvals before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the two merged split changes, is assigned to this PR, and has defined the remaining product and packaging boundary in the discussion.
